note: Written after the routing pilot, with different wording and no reuse of pilot cases. It is frozen for route-selection scoring only. Counterfactual answer replay has NOT been run against it, and answer quality was not judged; those two columns are reported as unmeasured. The set is development-visible from the moment it was written, so any later scoring that informs a design decision retires it.

labels.escalation_required: the turn needs personal memory, a state read, or a memory/calendar write
labels.fast_path_sufficient: the turn is answered correctly by chat itself, including its own device handling
labels.undetermined: too vague to score without a human judgement call
